name: Hilary of Arles
contribution: A bishop of Arles in Southern France.

checks.lead: Hilary of Arles, also known by his Latin name Hilarius (c. 403–449), was a bishop of Arles in Southern France. He is venerated as a saint in the Eastern Orthodox Church and Roman Catholic Church, with 5 May being his feast day.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
